title: Independent external validation of virtual multiplex immunofluorescence from H&E reveals that predicted channels encode tissue composition rather than cell identity
description:
This record contains the analysis code and derived results for an independent external validation of GigaTIME, a deep-learning model that predicts 23-channel virtual multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) from a single haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) whole-slide image.

What is included
- analysis/ - Python pipeline for tile extraction, reproduction of the official colour-normalisation and channel-decoding protocol, model inference, and metric computation.
- analysis/results/ - the derived result files (JSON) that underlie every figure, table and reported statistic in the manuscript.
- figures/ - publication-quality figure files (PDF and PNG).
- docs/ - dataset accession list, reproduction instructions and environment specification.

Validation layers
1. Pixel level: 945 HEMIT patches.
2. Spot level: 15,489 spots from GSE230424.
3. Patient level: 222 TCGA-THCA samples with matched RPPA protein measurements.
4. Single-cell level: 994,729 cells from 41 ORION-CRC patients.

Companion manuscript: "Independent external validation of virtual multiplex immunofluorescence from H&E reveals that predicted channels encode tissue composition rather than cell identity" (under review).
